scientific_ceiling: EM2 narrow independent-safety-evidence/specification boundaries in the pinned public simulator only

interpretation.primary: The frozen independent-state certification arm did not improve the preregistered safety outcomes over the shared disturbed-observation arm. Under noise 0.1 it increased any-truth-violation episode rate from 0.66 to 0.82; under noise 1.0 it increased mean truth-violation fraction from 0.7267 to 0.8537. Independence by itself is therefore not a sufficient safety condition in this adapter.
interpretation.secondary: The current-spec arm produced zero truth-violation episodes in all 50 seeds, while the stale permissive specification produced a truth violation in all 50 seeds and a mean truth-violation fraction of 0.7059. This externally supports the separation CorrectEnforcement != CorrectSpecification in the pinned simulator.
interpretation.analysis_normalization: The raw adapter repeats the current-spec independent-state noise=0 run. Exact duplicate rows were removed only for derived episode metrics; raw evidence remains unchanged.
